name: QES
recent: QES 完成向 Ray Tech Singapore 发行 83,276,260 股新股（占 10% 股权，每股 RM0.53），并已上市交易。公司同时以 SGD5.47 million 收购新加坡两间办公室单位，并脱售 Applied Engineering Technology (M) 的 30% 股权。最新季度营收与净利均环比增长。
notable: 完成向 Ray Tech Singapore 发行 83,276,260 股新股（10% 股权），每股 RM0.53，并已上市。
以 SGD5,470,000 收购新加坡 Space Nova 两间办公室单位。
脱售 Applied Engineering Technology (M) 的 30% 股权，现金代价 RM1,134,000。
risks: 新股发行导致现有股东股权被稀释约 10%。
多名风险委员会与审计委员会成员变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM78.84 million，环比增长 35.3%，同比微增 1.9%；净利为 RM7.01 million，环比增长 89.5%，同比增长 58.2%，净利率从 6.3% 提升至 8.9%。

recent_en: QES completed the issuance of 83,276,260 new shares (10% stake at RM0.53 each) to Ray Tech Singapore, which have been listed. The company also agreed to acquire two Singapore office units for SGD5.47 million and disposed of its 30% stake in Applied Engineering Technology (M). Latest quarterly revenue and net profit both grew sequentially.
notable_en: Completed issuance of 83,276,260 new shares (10% stake) to Ray Tech Singapore at RM0.53 each, which have been listed.
Acquiring two office units at Space Nova, Singapore for SGD5,470,000.
Disposed of 30% equity interest in Applied Engineering Technology (M) for RM1,134,000 cash.
risks_en: The new share issuance dilutes existing shareholders by approximately 10%.
Several changes in the Risk Committee and Audit Committee members.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM78.84 million, up 35.3% QoQ and 1.9% YoY; net profit was RM7.01 million, up 89.5% QoQ and 58.2% YoY, with net margin improving from 6.3% to 8.9%.
